jobs.title: Engineering Director, Foundation Services
jobs.description:
Join the Future of Security at Netskope

Netskope (NASDAQ: NTSK) is a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era. We secure and accelerate cloud, data, and AI in real time, everywhere. Thousands of customers, including more than 30 of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and the powerful NewEdge network to gain full visibility and control without performance trade-offs.

At Netskope, our technology is driven by our greatest strength: our people. We believe that belonging powers innovation, and success is both personal and organizational. We embrace differences in gender, ethnicity, beliefs, ability, and identity, creating an environment where every voice is heard and respected. We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Join a team where you belong, where you are encouraged to be an entrepreneur, and where together, we continue to redefine the landscape of security.

Visit Careers at Netskope to learn more. Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

About The Role

Imagine leading the team that keeps the heart of a global security platform beating. At Netskope, our Foundation Engineering team manages the near real-time configuration propagation across more than 100 global data centers. We are looking for a Director of Engineering who doesn't just manage but inspires—someone who can combine deep technical judgment with an AI-first leadership philosophy to help us scale our foundational cloud services to new heights.

What’s In It For You

You’ll be at the helm of a high-impact team building the essential systems that every other service at Netskope depends on. You will have the agency to shape the technical direction of our global cloud infrastructure, drive engineering excellence through AI integration, and mentor the next generation of engineering leaders within our organization.

What You’ll Be Doing

Leading People and Driving Execution -

Coach and Grow: You will manage and mentor engineering managers and tech leads, driving organizational growth through strategic hiring and hands-on coaching.
Own the Delivery: You’ll be responsible for the end-to-end delivery of scalable, resilient foundational services across our 100+ global data centers.
Collaborate Across the Board: You’ll work closely with Product, Program Management, and other engineering service owners to align priorities and clear any technical roadblocks.

Technical Vision and Innovation -

Architect the Future: Lead the architecture for distributed systems, runtime synchronization, and high-volume, high-availability cloud infrastructure.
Embrace AI-First: Foster a culture where AI isn't just a buzzword; you'll integrate AI tools into daily workflows to accelerate velocity and eliminate operational toil.

What You Bring To The Table

Deep Experience: You have 15+ years in software engineering, with at least 5 years specifically managing managers and multi-team organizations.
Technical Expertise: You are an expert in distributed systems, infra-services, data synchronization, cloud infrastructure, and Kubernetes.
Leadership Track Record: You have a proven ability to navigate cross-team negotiations, resolve bottlenecks, and maintain the highest engineering standards.
AI Savvy: You have hands-on experience leveraging AI to boost team performance and delivery leverage.
Distributed Team Leadership: Experience leading remote teams across multiple countries and time zones.

Nice to have

A background in cybersecurity or network security technologies.
Experience with Kubernetes and containerized deployments at scale.
Familiarity with observability, monitoring, and on-call operations.
A track record of reducing operational toil through automation and AI-driven tooling.

Education

A BS in Computer Science or an equivalent technical degree is required.
An MS in Computer Science or an equivalent technical degree is strongly preferred.

Compensation:

At Netskope, salary is one component of our competitive total rewards package. The salary range for this position is as listed below. This is a national range. For purposes of complying with applicable laws, the range applies to candidates in California, Colorado, Illinois, Maryland, New York, Washington, and other states.

The successful candidate’s starting pay will also be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, location, and market conditions.

For all sales roles, the posted salary range is the On Target Earnings (OTE) range for the role, which is the sum of base salary and target commission amount at 100% goal achievement.

In addition to salary, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation such as participation in a bonus plan (for non-sales roles) and a stock award program. Candidates may also be eligible for a comprehensive health plan and other benefits that can be reviewed at Netskope Benefits site.

Salary Range

$154,000—$312,000 USD

Recognize business needs and identify software solutions that enable both internal and external customers to manage their processes more effectively and efficiently;

jobs.title: Director, Supply Chain Engineering
jobs.description:
About Nscale

Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.

We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you’ll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you’ll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.

About The Role

We’re hiring a Director, Supply Chain Engineering to build the systems that take Nscale from demand signal to deployed compute.

This role sits within Corporate Technology and reports to the SVP, Corporate Technology, partnering closely with Data Center and AI Infrastructure teams, as well as Finance, Procurement, and Operations. You’ll design, build, and deploy the systems, platforms, and workflows spanning demand signal, hardware configuration and BOM development, supplier and ODM coordination, logistics and staging, spare inventory management, and more. You won’t run supply chain operations or own procurement—you’ll work alongside those owners and own how the work is represented in software.

Success means this work runs on systems rather than spreadsheets. Teams will work from shared, accurate data, changes will propagate without manual chasing, and routine coordination will be handled through automation and agentic workflows. Your work will directly determine how quickly Nscale can turn hardware into live compute.

What you'll be doing

Platform Ownership & Roadmap

Own the supply chain technology stack end to end, including strategy, implementation, platform health, configuration, integrations, upgrades, and roadmap planning.
Identify capability gaps and lead the evaluation, procurement, and implementation of new tools.
Build and maintain a templated, repeatable deployment model for supply chain systems across data centers and regions.

Integration & Data Architecture

Define and govern integration architecture across supply chain, finance, procurement, logistics, and infrastructure platforms.
Ensure reliable data exchange and auditability across connected systems.
Collaboratively define the data model and maintain data integrity across platforms.
Design workflows that connect each stage of the supply chain so one team’s output becomes another team’s reliable input.

Automation & Workflow Engineering

Build systems and workflows spanning demand signals, hardware configuration, BOM development, supplier and ODM coordination, logistics, staging, and spare inventory management.
Replace spreadsheet-based processes and manual coordination with scalable systems, automation, and agentic workflows.
Ensure changes propagate across teams and systems without unnecessary manual intervention.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

Serve as the primary technology partner for supply chain technology across Data Center, AI Infrastructure, Finance, Procurement, and Operations.
Manage competing demands across teams and regions while maintaining clear priorities and governance.
Own vendor relationships, contract performance, and platform renewals for purchased systems and services, applying a total-cost-of-ownership lens.
Align cross-functional stakeholders around shared standards and scalable ways of working.

KPIs

Adoption of shared systems over spreadsheet-based processes
Accuracy and integrity of cross-platform supply chain data
Reliability of integrations and change propagation
Speed from hardware demand signal to live compute

What You Must Bring

10+ years of experience in supply chain technology, enterprise systems, or a closely related field
5+ years building supply chain or supply chain adjacent technology in a complex operational environment
3+ years deploying technology systems across multiple sites or regions
Functional experience with platforms supporting to source-to-contract, BOM management, asset tracking, procure-to-pay platforms, and ERP systems
Experience in data center, hardware infrastructure, or GPU/AI compute supply chains
Proven ability to manage competing stakeholder demands while maintaining clear standards
Comfortable operating in a fast-paced evolving environment

What Sets You Apart (Preferred Qualifications)

Familiarity with DCIM/IPAM tooling and cross-border hardware logistics
Experience supporting M&A integration or global expansion from a systems perspective

What we can offer you

At Nscale, you'll find a collaborative, supportive, and innovative environment where your contributions spark real impact. We're building something extraordinary, and we want you at the core.

Highly competitive US compensation package (base + bonus + equity), with performance reviews every 12 months.

Join one of the fastest-growing AI infrastructure companies — your chance to directly shape how global AI capacity is planned and deployed.

Expect a dynamic progression plan tailored to your ambitions. Grow by leading critical cross-functional initiatives and shaping capital strategy — always with our full support.

Human-First Flexibility: We treat you as humans first. Our flexible workplace trusts Nscalers to deliver, giving you the autonomy to shape your day around life's moments.

Equal Opportunities Statement

We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

The responsibilities outlined in this job description are not exhaustive and are intended to provide a general overview of the position. The employee may be required to perform additional duties, tasks, and responsibilities as assigned by management, consistent with the skills and qualifications required for the role.

Salary Range

The range below reflects the base salary for the position. Actual compensation may vary based on job-related factors such as skill set, experience, education, and location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus, equity, and/or commission programs. Nscale may offer a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, flexible paid time off, parental leave, and retirement plan participation.

Salary Range: $160,000 USD - $270,000 USD

.

The Senior Engineering Manager, Tank Monitoring IoT Platform, is responsible for leading the development and delivery of the software solutions that power our Tank Monitoring platform. This includes cloud-based SaaS applications, mobile applications, platform services, and firmware deliverables.

This role combines strong technical leadership, people leadership, and disciplined execution. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of building and delivering scalable cloud-native software platforms, leading high-performing engineering teams, and making architectural decisions that support long-term business growth. They will also champion a quality-first engineering culture, ensuring high standards for reliability, security, test automation, operational excellence, and customer satisfaction

The Senior Engineering Manager will partner closely with Product Management, Sales, Operations, and other business leaders to deliver innovative, secure, and highly reliable solutions that create value for our customers.

Responsibilities

The Senior Engineering Manager will:

Own end-to-end software delivery for the Tank IoT Platform, including SaaS applications, mobile applications, cloud services, and firmware deliverables.
Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing engineering team while fostering a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Establish and drive execution against development plans, release schedules, and deployment timelines to deliver predictable outcomes.
Provide technical leadership for architecture reviews, solution design, technology selection, and key engineering decisions.
Guide the evolution of cloud-native, distributed, and event-driven systems that are scalable, secure, resilient, and maintainable.
Build strong partnerships with Product Management, Sales, Operations, and senior leadership to align priorities and execute successfully.
Champion engineering best practices, including Agile delivery, DevOps, CI/CD, observability, testing automation, and operational excellence.
Maintain exceptionally high standards for software quality, reliability, security, and engineering accountability, continuously raising the bar through data-driven improvement and disciplined execution.
Demonstrated abilty and willingness to use AI tools to improve productivity, decision-making, work quality, and to reduce costs.
The successful candidate must be able to identify appropriate AI use cases and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs.
Other duties as assigned.

Requirements

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field. Master's Degree in Computer Science or related field preferred.
A minimum of 8 years’ experience in software engineering and 3 years’ experience in people management.
Proven track record designing and delivering large-scale SaaS platforms leveraging modern data architectures and analytics capabilities. Experience with Microsoft Azure cloud services; Azure certifications preferred.
Deep expertise in cloud-native architecture, distributed systems, DevOps practices, and modern software design patterns. Experience designing and operating event-driven architectures, real-time streaming platforms, and large-scale data processing systems.
Hands-on experience designing and developing software using object-oriented languages such as C# and .NET, with full-stack development experience preferred.
Understanding of RDBMS and NoSQL databases, with the ability to select and architect appropriate storage solutions. Experience with SQL Server, Azure Cosmos DB, and Azure Blob Storage preferred.
Proven experience designing and delivering highly available, fault-tolerant systems, including multi-region architectures, disaster recovery strategies, and uptime SLAs of 99.9% or greater.
Understanding of cybersecurity best practices, including secure software development, secure-by-design principles, DevSecOps, and vulnerability management.
Maintains high standards for quality assurance and team accountability, takes proactive action to drive continuous improvement, and consistently raises the bar to build and sustain a high-performing team.
Understanding of Agile principles and demonstrated success leading Agile software delivery across multiple teams and initiatives.
Proven ability to recruit, develop, and retain top engineering talent, building high-performance teams that integrate effectively within the broader organization.
Strong collaborator with the ability to drive alignment and execution across cross-functional teams, senior leadership, and key stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability and willingness to use AI tools to improve productivity, decision-making, work quality, and to reduce costs. The successful candidate must be able to identify appropriate AI use cases and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs.
Preferred: Expertise in applied machine learning and ML-Ops, including successful deployment of production-grade ML solutions at scale.

Telular, a business unit of AMETEK, is a technology leader in IoT solutions that combine SaaS, cloud services, proprietary products, and data analytics to help customers unlock new revenue opportunities, lower operating costs, and improve profitability. Headquartered in Herndon, VA, with additional offices in Atlanta, Chicago, and Charlotte, Telular has delivered innovative connected solutions for more than 30 years. Operating at significant scale with over 1M devices deployed, the company has been a disruptive force in the IoT market. Telular's solutions serve a diverse set of industries, including trucking and asset management (trailer and intermodal asset tracking), petroleum logistics, industrial tank monitoring, commercial and residential security, fire monitoring, and emerging home automation.

Manages team delivering scalable distributed systems and components on a 2–4 quarter horizon. Guides teams to design fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems, set SLO‑aligned durability/availability targets, and implement resiliency mechanisms (load‑shedding, throttling, rate‑limiting). Provides oversight for KPIs, telemetry, and moderately complex dashboards; directs design of functional/correctness requirements, fault‑injection tests, and replication/synchronization strategies. Ensures proactive incident management, operational readiness, and on‑call coverage; drives encryption/access control practices, remediation plans, and compliance documentation. Oversees development and maintenance of automation/IaC and partners with teams on change‑management plans enabling safe patching, updates, and rollbacks.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture – System Scalability:

Manages the development and implementation of scalable distributed systems and components across multiple teams, including the effective use of distributed state management tools.
Oversees code and/or system optimization efforts for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements within and across teams to support hyper-scale systems.
Guides teams to define scalability requirements for owned components and ensures design and implementation requirements are met.
Manages the use of data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
Ensures team accurately designs performance and load testing.

System Design & Architecture – System Reliability Design:

Manages the strategy for building fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by guiding the implementation of redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
Develops design strategies for systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
Leads implementation and optimization initiatives across teams for approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.

Oversees the building and customization of moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health.

Guides teams to design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.

Job Summary

The Senior Director, Strategic Platform Execution leads a global organization accountable for bringing TerumoBCT's devices, disposables, and software to market. Is the senior authority and "go to" global leader for platform, program, and project execution across the devices, disposables, and software portfolio, and represents the organization on significant matters with internal and external stakeholders

Crowell & Moring LLP is an international law firm with offices in the United States, Europe, MENA, and Asia that represents clients in litigation and arbitration, regulatory and policy, intellectual property, and transactional and corporate matters. We are committed to delivering responsive, high-quality, and professional service to our clients and to one another, while continuously elevating standards of excellence across every aspect of our work.

Job Summary

The Director of Technology Strategy and Portfolio Management serves as a key strategic partner to the CIO, helping advance the Firm’s technology vision and position IT as a business-focused, value-generating function. This role provides leadership and operational direction for the firm’s technology strategy, planning, portfolio management, and technology delivery. This role helps translate firm priorities into coordinated technology initiatives, ensuring projects and services are properly prioritized, resourced, governed, and delivered with measurable value.

The Director oversees strategic roadmap and portfolio planning, budgeting, reporting, vendor management, contracts and coordination, business analysis and relationship management, and strategic execution, while working closely with IT, firm leadership, administrative leaders, practice leaders, and other stakeholders to support effective decision-making, operational efficiency, reliable user support, and continued innovation across the firm.

Job Responsibilities

Oversee the development, execution, and ongoing refinement of the firm’s annual technology strategy, ensuring alignment with business priorities, operational needs, and long-term firm goals. Partner with the CIO to develop the firmwide, strategic technology roadmap.
Oversee the technology portfolio management process, including intake, prioritization, sequencing, resourcing, investment review, progress tracking, and benefits realization.
Leads the continuous improvement and transformation of the IT business and operations model, including contemporary best practices and governance. This includes collaborating with key stakeholders on the architectural review board ensuring aligning with overall technology strategy.
Direct strategic technology programs and cross-functional initiatives from planning through delivery, ensuring clear ownership, milestones, dependencies, risks, and measurable outcomes.
Champion operational excellence across IT service delivery, including change management and client communications, ensuring business requirements are met with the proper technology solution and implementation, and ongoing relationship management and business reviews with the stakeholders.
Develop and deliver executive-level reports and presentations that communicate the impact of operational improvements and strategic initiatives.
Establish and monitor service performance metrics, KPIs, SLAs, and reporting practices to ensure support levels technology project management and implementations meet or exceed user expectations and drive continuous improvement.
Oversee IT financial operations, including annual budgeting, forecasting, variance review, cost optimization, resource allocation, invoice and expense processing, and reporting on technology spend, performance, and value.
Partner with stakeholders and outsourced procurement services vendor to manage vendor selection, contract negotiation, supplier relationship management, service levels, renewals, and technology contract lifecycle processes.
Develop, maintain, and improve IT policies, procedures, governance practices, documentation, methodologies, and operating standards to support consistency, accountability, and compliance.
Partner with firm leaders, administrative departments, practice groups, attorneys, professional staff, vendors, and other stakeholders to understand needs, evaluate solutions, and support effective technology decision-making.
Drive collaboration and communication between IT and user communities, ensuring users are informed of service status, project progress, support expectations, and technology changes.
Identify opportunities to improve quality, efficiency, automation, self-service, and innovation in technology services and support delivery.
Support risk management, information security, business continuity, and recovery planning efforts to protect firm and client information and minimize disruption to firm operations.
Provide strategic direction, coaching, performance management, and professional development for assigned teams, fostering a collaborative, service-oriented, and continuous improvement culture.
Other strategic initiatives as assigned by the CIO.

Strong knowledge of technology strategy, portfolio management, IT operations, service delivery, governance, budgeting, vendor management, and enterprise technology planning.
Experience with contemporary project and portfolio management tools, including AI integration.
Ability to translate business priorities into practical technology plans, investment recommendations, operating models, and measurable outcomes.
Strong understanding of IT service delivery, end-user support, , performance metrics, SLAs, and continuous improvement practices.

Strong leadership and team management skills, with the ability to coach, develop, and support high-performing teams in a complex, service-oriented environment.
Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with attorneys, professional staff, firm leadership, vendors, and technical teams.
Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and drive results.
Ability to establish structure, accountability, and transparency across complex technology initiatives, projects, and service delivery functions.
Demonstrated judgment, discretion, and ability to manage confidential and sensitive information.
Familiarity with law firm, professional services, or similarly complex business environments, including common enterprise platforms such as document management, knowledge management, Microsoft 365, IT service management, and collaboration tools.
Demonstrates a continuous commitment to elevating service standards by delivering responsive, high-quality support to internal and external clients and proactively identifying opportunities to improve the client experience in all non-legal interactions.

PMP certification, or related certification.

About Nscale

Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.

We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you’ll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you’ll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.

About The Role

We’re hiring a Director, Supply Chain Engineering to build the systems that take Nscale from demand signal to deployed compute.

This role sits within Corporate Technology and reports to the SVP, Corporate Technology, partnering closely with Data Center and AI Infrastructure teams, as well as Finance, Procurement, and Operations. You’ll design, build, and deploy the systems, platforms, and workflows spanning demand signal, hardware configuration and BOM development, supplier and ODM coordination, logistics and staging, spare inventory management, and more. You won’t run supply chain operations or own procurement—you’ll work alongside those owners and own how the work is represented in software.

Success means this work runs on systems rather than spreadsheets. Teams will work from shared, accurate data, changes will propagate without manual chasing, and routine coordination will be handled through automation and agentic workflows. Your work will directly determine how quickly Nscale can turn hardware into live compute.

What you'll be doing

Platform Ownership & Roadmap

Own the supply chain technology stack end to end, including strategy, implementation, platform health, configuration, integrations, upgrades, and roadmap planning.
Identify capability gaps and lead the evaluation, procurement, and implementation of new tools.
Build and maintain a templated, repeatable deployment model for supply chain systems across data centers and regions.

Integration & Data Architecture

Define and govern integration architecture across supply chain, finance, procurement, logistics, and infrastructure platforms.
Ensure reliable data exchange and auditability across connected systems.
Collaboratively define the data model and maintain data integrity across platforms.
Design workflows that connect each stage of the supply chain so one team’s output becomes another team’s reliable input.

Automation & Workflow Engineering

Build systems and workflows spanning demand signals, hardware configuration, BOM development, supplier and ODM coordination, logistics, staging, and spare inventory management.
Replace spreadsheet-based processes and manual coordination with scalable systems, automation, and agentic workflows.
Ensure changes propagate across teams and systems without unnecessary manual intervention.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

Serve as the primary technology partner for supply chain technology across Data Center, AI Infrastructure, Finance, Procurement, and Operations.
Manage competing demands across teams and regions while maintaining clear priorities and governance.
Own vendor relationships, contract performance, and platform renewals for purchased systems and services, applying a total-cost-of-ownership lens.
Align cross-functional stakeholders around shared standards and scalable ways of working.

KPIs

Adoption of shared systems over spreadsheet-based processes
Accuracy and integrity of cross-platform supply chain data
Reliability of integrations and change propagation
Speed from hardware demand signal to live compute

What You Must Bring

10+ years of experience in supply chain technology, enterprise systems, or a closely related field
5+ years building supply chain or supply chain adjacent technology in a complex operational environment
3+ years deploying technology systems across multiple sites or regions
Functional experience with platforms supporting to source-to-contract, BOM management, asset tracking, procure-to-pay platforms, and ERP systems
Experience in data center, hardware infrastructure, or GPU/AI compute supply chains
Proven ability to manage competing stakeholder demands while maintaining clear standards
Comfortable operating in a fast-paced evolving environment

What Sets You Apart (Preferred Qualifications)

Familiarity with DCIM/IPAM tooling and cross-border hardware logistics
Experience supporting M&A integration or global expansion from a systems perspective

What we can offer you

At Nscale, you'll find a collaborative, supportive, and innovative environment where your contributions spark real impact. We're building something extraordinary, and we want you at the core.

Highly competitive US compensation package (base + bonus + equity), with performance reviews every 12 months.

Join one of the fastest-growing AI infrastructure companies — your chance to directly shape how global AI capacity is planned and deployed.

Expect a dynamic progression plan tailored to your ambitions. Grow by leading critical cross-functional initiatives and shaping capital strategy — always with our full support.

Human-First Flexibility: We treat you as humans first. Our flexible workplace trusts Nscalers to deliver, giving you the autonomy to shape your day around life's moments.

We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

This role provides leadership and operational direction for the firm’s technology strategy, planning, portfolio management, and technology delivery. This role helps translate firm priorities into coordinated technology initiatives, ensuring projects and services are properly prioritized, resourced, governed, and delivered with measurable value.

The Director oversees strategic roadmap and portfolio planning, budgeting, reporting, vendor management, contracts and coordination, business analysis and relationship management, and strategic execution, while working closely with IT, firm leadership, administrative leaders, practice leaders, and other stakeholders to support effective decision-making, operational efficiency, reliable user support, and continued innovation across the firm.

Leads the continuous improvement and transformation of the IT business and operations model, including contemporary best practices and governance. This includes collaborating with key stakeholders on the architectural review board ensuring aligning with overall technology strategy.
Direct strategic technology programs and cross-functional initiatives from planning through delivery, ensuring clear ownership, milestones, dependencies, risks, and measurable outcomes.

Develop and deliver executive-level reports and presentations that communicate the impact of operational improvements and strategic initiatives.
Establish and monitor service performance metrics, KPIs, SLAs, and reporting practices to ensure support levels technology project management and implementations meet or exceed user expectations and drive continuous improvement.

Other strategic initiatives as assigned by the CIO.
